articleTitle: Neuropsychiatric adverse effects associated with the use of levetiracetam in adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
takeaways: This systematic review and meta-analysis examined neuropsychiatric side effects of levetiracetam (an anti-seizure medication) in adults over 16 with epilepsy but no existing psychiatric conditions, providing updated safety data for this commonly prescribed medication
The study specifically compared neuropsychiatric adverse effects between levetiracetam, placebo, and other anti-seizure medications to quantify relative risks of mood and behavioral changes

Researchers focused on adults without pre-existing psychiatric comorbidities to isolate the direct neuropsychiatric effects attributable to levetiracetam rather than underlying mental health conditions
The analysis provides evidence-based data on the frequency and types of mood, behavioral, and cognitive side effects that may occur when starting levetiracetam treatment for epilepsy
